SELECT im.id, im.evaluation_id, ev.evaluation_no, ev.company_id, c.name AS company_name, im.item_id, i.title AS item_title, im.requested_by, ru.name AS requester_name, im.requested_at, im.request_content, im.response_content, im.response_user_id, au.name AS responder_name, im.responded_at, im.response_due_date, im.status, im.created_at FROM tb_evaluation_improvement im LEFT JOIN tb_evaluation ev ON ev.id = im.evaluation_id AND ev.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN tb_company c ON c.id = ev.company_id AND c.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN tb_evaluation_item i ON i.id = im.item_id AND i.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN tb_user ru ON ru.id = im.requested_by AND ru.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN tb_user au ON au.id = im.response_user_id AND au.deleted = 0 WHERE im.id = #{id} AND im.deleted = 0

mapper.update: UPDATE tb_evaluation_improvement SET response_content = #{responseContent}, response_user_id = #{responseUserId}, responded_at = SYSUTCDATETIME(), status = 'RESPONDED', updated_at = SYSUTCDATETIME() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
